_note: mzPeakValidator imaging-profile CV placement. Evaluated only when the archive is imaging (the engine rule sets require_imaging). The mzPeak analogue of the mzML MALDI object rules: an imaging scan MUST carry promoted pixel coordinates. position x/y are IMS accessions that columns of the scan facet carry: through a column_mapping entry in the files[] entry of spectra_metadata.parquet (path scan.position_x, accession IMS:1000050 — the imaging profile's column names, spec PR #25), or, as earlier drafts wrote them, inflected into the column name (scan.IMS_1000050_position_x).
